notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.9
notes.content: [p][b]This update introduces major systems to the homeworld, including new resources, buildings, inventory logic, player stat changes, UI polish, save/load functionality, and the foundation for research progression.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New: Inventory System[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented a full inventory system with clear separation between [b]Resources[/b] and [b]Items[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resources[/b] (e.g. oil, power, research points) are kept on death.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Items[/b] (e.g. tools, consumables, blueprints) are lost on death, introducing a risk-reward element to exploration, expanding on the roguelike aspects.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Player Stat Change: Overheating[/h3][list][*][p]Replaced [b]Stamina[/b] with a new [b]Overheating[/b] system.[/p][/*][*][p]Performing tasks builds up heat over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Overheating reduces performance and requires cooldown periods.[/p][/*][*][p]Reflects the robotic nature of your character and adds tension during prolonged activity.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Resource: Research Points[/h3][list][*][p]Research Points have been added as a new collectible and storable resource.[/p][/*][*][p]Used to unlock advanced technologies, upgrades, and blueprints.[/p][/*][*][p]Earned by defeating enemies, completing objectives, or processing rare materials.[/p][/*][*][p]Stored globally and persist through death and level transitions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Resource: Oil[/h3][list][*][p]Added as a key fuel resource for your base.[/p][/*][*][p]Extracted from the environment using Oil Extractors.[/p][/*][*][p]Used to fuel power generators and some crafting recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Stored in Oil Tanks for efficient management and long-term use.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Resource: Power[/h3][list][*][p]Power has been added as a core energy resource for your base.[/p][/*][*][p]Used to operate buildings, machinery, and automation systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Generated by oil-fuelled and solar generators.[/p][/*][*][p]Stored in Power Cores to provide backup and ensure steady supply.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Building System Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Building component system updated for better performance, modularity, and resource logic handling.[/p][/*][*][p]Prepared for future expansion with an easy-to-use modular framework to support quick feature additions and scalability.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]New Buildings[/h3][list][*][p][b]Oil Extractor[/b] – Extracts raw oil from environmental patches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power Generator[/b] – Consumes oil to produce power.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Solar Generator[/b] – Produces free power during the daytime, with no fuel cost.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Oil Tank[/b] – Stores large amounts of refined oil.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power Core[/b] – Stores generated power for later use.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Expanded resource UI with updated icons, resource bars, and contextual tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved building placement feedback and alignment visuals.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Save / Load System[/h3][list][*][p]Full Save and Load system now active.[/p][/*][*][p]Autosave occurs:[/p][list][*][p]On level transitions[/p][/*][*][p]During major player actions (e.g. placing buildings)[/p][/*][*][p]At 5-minute set intervals[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Implemented a full inventory system with clear separation between [b]Resources[/b] and [b]Items[/b].
[b]Resources[/b] (e.g. oil, power, research points) are kept on death.
[b]Items[/b] (e.g. tools, consumables, blueprints) are lost on death, introducing a risk-reward element to exploration, expanding on the roguelike aspects.

tags.balance_change: Performing tasks builds up heat over time.
Overheating reduces performance and requires cooldown periods.
Reflects the robotic nature of your character and adds tension during prolonged activity.

tags.feature: Research Points have been added as a new collectible and storable resource.
Used to unlock advanced technologies, upgrades, and blueprints.
Earned by defeating enemies, completing objectives, or processing rare materials.
Stored globally and persist through death and level transitions.
Added as a key fuel resource for your base.
Extracted from the environment using Oil Extractors.
Used to fuel power generators and some crafting recipes.
Stored in Oil Tanks for efficient management and long-term use.
Power has been added as a core energy resource for your base.
Used to operate buildings, machinery, and automation systems.
Generated by oil-fuelled and solar generators.
Stored in Power Cores to provide backup and ensure steady supply.
Building component system updated for better performance, modularity, and resource logic handling.
Prepared for future expansion with an easy-to-use modular framework to support quick feature additions and scalability.
[b]Oil Extractor[/b] – Extracts raw oil from environmental patches.
[b]Power Generator[/b] – Consumes oil to produce power.
[b]Solar Generator[/b] – Produces free power during the daytime, with no fuel cost.

[b]Power Core[/b] – Stores generated power for later use.
Expanded resource UI with updated icons, resource bars, and contextual tooltips.
Improved building placement feedback and alignment visuals.
Full Save and Load system now active.

On level transitions
During major player actions (e.g. placing buildings)
At 5-minute set intervals

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.8
notes.content: [p][b]This update marks a significant shift in gameplay perspective, transitioning from a top-down shooter to a third-person shooter, alongside key combat, map, and UI improvements.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Major Gameplay Change[/h3][list][*][p]Changed the core gameplay perspective from [b]top-down shooter[/b] to [b]third-person shooter[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked camera, controls, and player movement to fit the new third-person style.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Map & Environment[/h3][list][*][p]Expanded and refined the [b]testing map[/b] for the new gameplay perspective.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new [b]environmental props[/b] to complement the third-person experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Combat Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Balanced combat mechanics to suit third-person gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]VFX for Hover Enemies[/b] for better visual clarity.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Performance & Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Optimised AI by limiting active enemies based on player count.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision issues with destroyed enemies.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]UI Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Continued development of [b]Main Menu[/b] and [b]Pause Menu[/b] to improve navigation and usability.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Changed the core gameplay perspective from top-down shooter to third-person shooter.
Reworked camera, controls, and player movement to fit the new third-person style.
Expanded and refined the testing map for the new gameplay perspective.
Added new environmental props to complement the third-person experience.

tags.balance_change: Balanced combat mechanics to suit third-person gameplay.

tags.feature: Added VFX for Hover Enemies for better visual clarity.
Optimised AI by limiting active enemies based on player count.

tags.bug: Fixed collision issues with destroyed enemies.

tags.feature: Continued development of Main Menu and Pause Menu to improve navigation and usability.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.7
notes.content: [p][b]This update brings enhanced AI control, flexible world design, new combat mechanics, accessibility features, and controller support.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]AI & World Design[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented advanced [b]AI behaviour control[/b] with EQS (Environment Query System) usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-designed asset modularity to improve flexibility in world design and level creation.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Combat & Abilities[/h3][list][*][p]Added new [b]weapon modes[/b] for varied combat options.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]Dash[/b] ability for smoother player movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Projectiles now support [b]colour changes[/b] for better visual feedback.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Accessibility & Controls[/h3][list][*][p]Added an [b]accessibility feature[/b] to assist with aiming direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Added full [b]controller support[/b] for enhanced gameplay options.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Implemented advanced AI behaviour control with EQS (Environment Query System) usage.
Re-designed asset modularity to improve flexibility in world design and level creation.
Added new weapon modes for varied combat options.
Improved Dash ability for smoother player movement.
Projectiles now support colour changes for better visual feedback.
Added an accessibility feature to assist with aiming direction.
Added full controller support for enhanced gameplay options.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.6
notes.content: [p][b]This update addresses multiple bug fixes, visual improvements, AI and UI enhancements to improve overall gameplay experience.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed health bar displaying integral units instead of smooth values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed melee and ranged damage values not saving correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug reporter hiding the mouse cursor after closing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the ability to “spam click” melee attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character rotation when off-camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI navigation and rotation issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug reporter functionality.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Visual & UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]General visual improvements across the game.[/p][/*][*][p]HUD and UX improvements for clearer player feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded and improved [b]auto-aim[/b] functionality for better responsiveness.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed health bar displaying integral units instead of smooth values.
Fixed melee and ranged damage values not saving correctly.
Fixed bug reporter hiding the mouse cursor after closing.
Fixed the ability to “spam click” melee attacks.
Fixed AI navigation and rotation issues.

tags.feature: Expanded and improved [b]auto-aim[/b] functionality for better responsiveness.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.5
notes.content: [p][b]This update introduces new scoring mechanics, player abilities, UI improvements, and fixes to enhance gameplay and stability.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Game Score[/b] system to track player performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]Score Multiplier[/b] to reward skillful play.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability for the player to [b]jump[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented [b]revision control[/b] to better manage updates and changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]player experience[/b] system for progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled interaction with the [b]Upgrade Station[/b] for player upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Visual & UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Enhanced visuals on the [b]Playtest Map[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Re-fixed [b]sound attenuation[/b] for accurate audio behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]UI changes[/b] for improved user experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues with [b]Save/Load[/b] functionality.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added [b]Game Score[/b] system to track player performance.
Introduced [b]Score Multiplier[/b] to reward skillful play.
Added the ability for the player to [b]jump[/b].
Implemented [b]revision control[/b] to better manage updates and changes.
Added [b]player experience[/b] system for progression.
Enabled interaction with the [b]Upgrade Station[/b] for player upgrades.

tags.bug: Re-fixed [b]sound attenuation[/b] for accurate audio behavior.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.4
notes.content: [h1]Gameplay Enhancements & UI Fixes[/h1][p][b]This update adds new gameplay features, improves AI behaviour, enhances audio, and fixes UI inconsistencies for a smoother player experience.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]assisted aiming[/b] to improve player targeting accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]sound attenuation[/b] for more realistic audio distance effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a basic [b]character sheet[/b] for player stats and overview.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]"Continue"[/b] button to the main menu to streamline game resumption.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Improved [b]AI projectile collision[/b] detection for more reliable enemy behaviour.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue where [b]Exit Game[/b] option incorrectly displayed as [b]Exit to Menu[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added assisted aiming to improve player targeting accuracy.
Introduced sound attenuation for more realistic audio distance effects.
Added a basic character sheet for player stats and overview.
Added a "Continue" button to the main menu to streamline game resumption.

tags.bug: Fixed issue where Exit Game option incorrectly displayed as Exit to Menu.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.3
notes.content: [p][b]This update introduces a new bug reporting utility and improvements to AI, map testing, and audio settings to enhance gameplay and user experience.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented a [b]bug reporting utility[/b] integrated with Codecks to streamline issue tracking and player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Expanded the [b]TopDownMap[/b] testing area to allow better player movement testing and navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Gunner AI[/b] logic to prevent enemies from spawning inside the floor.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]UI / Settings[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed audio settings so the volume defaults correctly instead of appearing muted on first launch.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Implemented a bug reporting utility integrated with Codecks to streamline issue tracking and player feedback.
Expanded the TopDownMap testing area to allow better player movement testing and navigation.

tags.bug: Updated Gunner AI logic to prevent enemies from spawning inside the floor.
Fixed audio settings so the volume defaults correctly instead of appearing muted on first launch.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.2
notes.content: [p][b]This update focuses on improving user experience with placeholder UI options, gameplay tweaks, and important bug fixes to ensure smoother play.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Added the ability to adjust [b]audio volume[/b] in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]"Return Home"[/b] button in the pause menu to quickly return to the hubworld.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Gameplay Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the [b]timer[/b] not updating properly during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed [b]collision from objective zones[/b] to prevent players from getting stuck or blocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the [b]enemy counter[/b] for more accurate and responsive feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]blocker height[/b] to fix z-fighting visual glitches in level geometry.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added the ability to adjust [b]audio volume[/b] in the settings menu.
Added a [b]"Return Home"[/b] button in the pause menu to quickly return to the hubworld.
